--Global

unit.hideWidget()

useDatabankValues = false --export: if checked and if values were saved in databank, parmaters will be loaded from the databank, if not, following ones will be used


version = "v0.4"
bg_pic = "assets.prod.novaquark.com/72511/428bafdf-f19c-4bdb-8610-5f81d9fd6424.jpg" --export: Background picture
sale_header = "" --export: Insert your heading line
--sale_pic = "assets.prod.novaquark.com/72511/03121bb6-c2d6-4330-9b3a-8aa124995cd0.jpg" --export: Insert a picture link of you item for sale - format 4:3
sale_price = 0 --export: Price per Batch
sale_volume = 1 --export: Notifier for the batch volume
tier = 1 --export: Tier for element
numberOfLines = 0 --export: Number of lines

craftDays = 0 --export: Craft time in days
craftHours = 0 --export: Craft time in hours
craftMins = 0 --export: Craft time in minutes
craftSecs = 1 --export: Craft time in seconds
autoCalc = true --export: AutoCalcuate CraftsPerDay Default:true


craftsPerDay = 0
craftSpeed = 0

if autoCalc == false then
craftsPerDay = 1 --export: CraftsPerDay manual
end
if autoCalc == true then
    --craftsPerDay = numberOfLines * (((craftDays * 24 * 60) + (craftHours * 60) + (craftMins))/ 1440)
     craftsPerDay = numberOfLines * ((1440 * 60) / ((craftDays * 24 * 60 * 60) + (craftHours * 60 * 60) + (craftMins * 60) + (craftSecs)))

    craftsPerDay = tonumber(string.format("%.2f", craftsPerDay))
end

if craftDays == 0 and craftHours == 0 then
    craftSpeed = craftMins.."mins "..craftSecs.."secs"
end
if craftDays == 0 and craftHours > 0 then
    craftSpeed = craftHours.."hrs "..craftMins.."mins "..craftSecs.."secs"
end
if craftDays > 0 then
    craftSpeed = craftDays.."days "..craftHours.."hrs "..craftMins.."mins"
end

if tier == 1 then
head_color_red = 0.43 -- Header description text color red - value 0-1
head_color_green = 0.65 -- Header description text color green - value 0-1
head_color_blue = 0.71 -- Header description text color blue - value 0-1
end
if tier == 2 then
head_color_red = 0.14 -- Header description text color red - value 0-1
head_color_green = 0.7 -- Header description text color green - value 0-1
head_color_blue = 0.3 -- Header description text color blue - value 0-1
end
if tier == 3 then
head_color_red = 0.26 -- Header description text color red - value 0-1
head_color_green = 0.63 -- Header description text color green - value 0-1
head_color_blue = 1 -- Header description text color blue - value 0-1
end
if tier == 4 then
head_color_red = 0.66 -- Header description text color red - value 0-1
head_color_green = 0.28 -- Header description text color green - value 0-1
head_color_blue = 0.66 -- Header description text color blue - value 0-1
end
if tier == 5 then
head_color_red = 1 -- Header description text color red - value 0-1
head_color_green = 0.62 -- Header description text color green - value 0-1
head_color_blue = 0.24 -- Header description text color blue - value 0-1
end


--##Allow and set these values if you want to override tier
--head_color_red = 1 --export: Header description text color red - value 0-1
--head_color_green = 3 --export: Header description text color green - value 0-1
--head_color_blue = 1 --export: Header description text color blue - value 0-1

--##Adjust these to change colors in other sections
head_color_trans = 1 -- Header description text transparency - value 0
bg_color_red = 0 -- Background color red - value 0-1
bg_color_green = 0.15 --Background color red - value 0-1
bg_color_blue = 0.15 -- Background color red - value 0-1
bg_color_trans = 0.8 -- Background transparency - value 0-1
head_strk_red = 1 -- Right description stroke color red - value 0-1
head_strk_green = 4 -- Right description stroke color green - value 0-1
head_strk_blue = 4 -- Right description stroke color blue - value 0-1
head_strk_trans = 1 -- Right description stroke transparency - value 0-1
desc_color_red = 1.5 --Right description text color red - value 0-1
desc_color_green = 1.5 -- Right description text color green - value 0-1
desc_color_blue = 1.5 -- Right description text color blue - value 0-1
desc_color_trans = 1 -- Right description text transparency - value 0-1
desc_bg_red = 0.05 -- Right description bg color red - value 0-1
desc_bg_green = 0.05 -- Right description bg color green - value 0-1
desc_bg_blue = 0.05 -- Right description bg color blue - value 0-1
desc_bg_trans = 0.9 -- Right description bg transparency - value 0-1
desc_strk_red = 0 -- Right description stroke color red - value 0-1
desc_strk_green = 0.9 -- Right description stroke color green - value 0-1
desc_strk_blue = 0.9 -- Right description stroke color blue - value 0-1
desc_strk_trans = 1 -- Right description stroke transparency - value 0-1


databank = nil
screens = {}
lights = {}
containerSlot = nil

for slot_name, slot in pairs(unit) do
    if
    type(slot) == "table"
            and type(slot.export) == "table"
            and slot.getClass
    then
        if slot.getClass():lower() == 'screenunit' 
            or slot.getClass():lower() == 'screensignunit' then
            slot.slotname = slot_name
            table.insert(screens,slot)
        end
        if slot.getClass():lower() == 'databankunit' then
            databank = slot
        end
        if slot.getClass():lower() == 'itemcontainer' then
            containerSlot = slot
        end
        if slot.getClass():lower() == 'lightunit' then
            slot.slotname = slot_name
            table.insert(lights,slot)
        end
    end
end


--##DEBUG
if #screens == 0 then
    system.print("No Screen Detected")
    unit.exit()
--else
--    table.sort(screens, function(a,b) return a.slotname < b.slotname end)
 --   local plural = ""
 --   if #screens > 1 then plural = "s" end
 --   system.print(#screens .. " Screen" .. plural .. " Connected")
end

--if #lights == 0 then
--    system.print("No Lights Detected")
--    unit.exit()
--else
--    table.sort(lights, function(a,b) return a.slotname < b.slotname end)
--    local plural = ""
--    if #lights > 1 then plural = "s" end
--    system.print(#lights .. " Lights" .. plural .. " Connected")
--end

--function checkSlots(a, b)
 -- return (a ~= nil and b ~= nil and
 --             string.match(a.getClass(), "Screen") and
 --             string.match(b.getClass(), "Container"))
--end



--#Setting databank values
options = {}
options.version = version
options.bg_pic = bg_pic
options.sale_header = sale_header

options.sale_price = sale_price
options.sale_volume = sale_volume
options.tier = tier
options.numberOfLines = numberOfLines

options.craftDays = craftDays
options.craftHours = craftHours
options.craftMins = craftMins
options.craftSecs = craftSecs
options.autoCalc = autoCalc

options.craftsPerDay = craftsPerDay
options.craftSpeed = craftSpeed

if databank == nil then
 --   system.print("No Databank Detected")
else
  --  system.print("Databank Connected")
    if (databank.hasKey("options")) and (useDatabankValues == true) then
        local db_options = json.decode(databank.getStringValue("options"))
        for key, value in pairs(options) do
            if db_options[key] then options[key] = db_options[key] end
        end
  --      system.print("Options Loaded From Databank")
    else
  --      system.print("Options Loaded From LUA Parameters")
    end
end

--system.print("Screens "..#screens.." Lights "..#lights.." Container "..#containerSlot.." Databank "..#databank)

-- Init Container Update
containerSlot.updateContent()

-- Init Screens
for s = 1, #screens, 1 do
    screens[s].activate()
end


if containerSlot.getItemsVolume() == 0 then
    for l = 1, #lights, 1 do  
        lights[l].setColor(1,0,0)
    end
end

if containerSlot.getItemsVolume() > 0 then
    for l = 1, #lights, 1 do
        lights[l].setColor(0,1,0)
    end
end

--Container check and output
F_container_update()

-- Screen Text
F_update_screen()
-- Set update timer
unit.setTimer("upd", 1)
--Container check and output
F_container_update()

-- Screen Text
F_update_screen()

-- Update Container
F_container_update()
-- Update Screen
F_update_screen()

-- Update Container
F_container_update()
-- Set inactive info
upd_time_msg = "--INACTIVE--"

if containerSlot.getItemsVolume() == 0 then
    for l = 1, #lights, 1 do  
        lights[l].setColor(1,0,0)
    end
end

if containerSlot.getItemsVolume() > 0 then
    for l = 1, #lights, 1 do
        lights[l].setColor(0,1,0)
    end
end

-- Update Screen
F_update_screen()

if databank ~= nil then
    databank.setStringValue("options", json.encode(options))
end

-- For 1 item batch

screenContent = [[

--------screenContent--------
-- Layer levels
local layer_bg = createLayer()
local layer = createLayer()
local layer2 = createLayer()

-- Misc
local rx, ry = getResolution()

-- other
local craftPerDay = crafts_scr_PerDay


-- Fonts
local font = loadFont("RefrigeratorDeluxe", rx*0.07)
local font_large = loadFont("RefrigeratorDeluxe", rx*0.14)
local font_normal = loadFont("RefrigeratorDeluxe", rx*0.035)
local font_small = loadFont("Play", rx*0.025)
local font_system = loadFont("RobotoCondensed", rx*0.02)



-- Background
addImage(layer_bg, loadImage(bg_pic), 0, 0, rx, ry)

--- Boxes and Frames
-- top full
setNextStrokeColor(layer, head_strk_red, head_strk_green, head_strk_blue, head_strk_trans)
setNextStrokeWidth(layer, 3)
setNextFillColor(layer, bg_red, bg_green, bg_blue, bg_trans) 
addBoxRounded(layer, rx*0.02, ry*0.03, rx*0.96, ry*0.15, 4)
-- Set default stroke
setDefaultStrokeColor(layer, Shape_BoxRounded, desc_strk_red, desc_strk_green, desc_strk_blue, desc_strk_trans)
setDefaultStrokeWidth(layer, Shape_BoxRounded, 2)
-- bg image left
setNextFillColor(layer, desc_bg_red, desc_bg_green, desc_bg_blue, desc_bg_trans)
addBoxRounded(layer, rx*0.02, ry*0.2, rx*0.43, ry*0.55, 4)
-- text right
setNextFillColor(layer, desc_bg_red, desc_bg_green, desc_bg_blue, desc_bg_trans)
addBoxRounded(layer, rx*0.46, ry*0.2, rx*0.52, ry*0.72, 4)
-- quantity bottom
setNextFillColor(layer, bg_red, bg_green, bg_blue, bg_trans) 
addBoxRounded(layer, rx*0.02, ry*0.77, rx*0.43, ry*0.15, 4)

--- Text Left Column
setDefaultFillColor(layer, Shape_Text, hd_red, hd_green, hd_blue, hd_trans) 
-- header
addText(layer, font, item_header, rx*0.05, ry*0.15)
-- qty
addText (layer2, font_large, "Qty ", rx*0.1, ry*0.44)
addText (layer2, font_large, quantity_scr_msg, rx*0.15, ry*0.68)

-- craft time 
addText(layer, font_normal, "Craft Time: "..craftSpeed_scr_msg, rx*0.03, ry*0.83)
addText(layer, font_normal, craftPerDay.." per Day from "..lines_scr_msg.." line(s)", rx*0.03, ry*0.9)

--- Text Right Column


-- sale text
setDefaultFillColor(layer, Shape_Text, desc_red, desc_green, desc_blue, desc_trans)

addText(layer, font_large, sale_price, rx*0.52, ry*0.5)
addText(layer, font_large, "each",rx*0.63, ry*0.75)

--- Bottom Line
addLine(layer, rx*0.02, ry*0.94, rx*0.98, ry*0.94) 
addText(layer, font_system, "Settlers - Dispenser View "..version.." / Original by Smourr Designs / Next volume update in: "..upd_time_scr_msg.." sec", rx*0.03, ry*0.98)




]]

function F_update_screen()
    -- Screen Text
    screen_msg = [[
    
    
    
    --------ScreenTextVariables--------
    local version = "]]..options.version..[["
    local bg_red = "]]..bg_color_red..[["
    local bg_green = "]]..bg_color_green..[["
    local bg_blue = "]]..bg_color_blue..[["
    local bg_trans = "]]..bg_color_trans..[["
    local hd_red = "]]..head_color_red..[["
    local hd_green = "]]..head_color_green..[["
    local hd_blue = "]]..head_color_blue..[["
    local hd_trans = "]]..head_color_trans..[["
    local head_strk_red = "]]..head_strk_red..[["
    local head_strk_green = "]]..head_strk_green..[["
    local head_strk_blue = "]]..head_strk_blue..[["
    local head_strk_trans = "]]..head_strk_trans..[["
    local desc_bg_red = "]]..desc_bg_red..[["
    local desc_bg_green = "]]..desc_bg_green..[["
    local desc_bg_blue = "]]..desc_bg_blue..[["
    local desc_bg_trans = "]]..desc_bg_trans..[["
    local desc_red = "]]..desc_color_red..[["
    local desc_green = "]]..desc_color_green..[["
    local desc_blue = "]]..desc_color_blue..[["
    local desc_trans = "]]..desc_color_trans..[["
    local desc_strk_red = "]]..desc_strk_red..[["
    local desc_strk_green = "]]..desc_strk_green..[["
    local desc_strk_blue = "]]..desc_strk_blue..[["
    local desc_strk_trans = "]]..desc_strk_trans..[["
    local bg_pic = "]]..options.bg_pic..[["
    local item_header = "]]..options.sale_header..[["
    local upd_time_scr_msg = "]]..upd_time_msg..[["
    local quantity_scr_msg = "]]..quantity_msg..[["
    local sale_price = "]]..options.sale_price..[["
    local sale_volume = "]]..options.sale_volume..[["
    local crafts_scr_PerDay = "]]..options.craftsPerDay..[["
    local craftSpeed_scr_msg = "]]..options.craftSpeed..[["
    local tier_scr_msg = "]]..options.tier..[["
    local lines_scr_msg = "]]..options.numberOfLines..[["
    ]]
    
    if sale_volume == 1 then
        for s = 1, #screens, 1 do
           screens[s].setRenderScript(screen_msg..screenContent)
        end
   -- slot2.setRenderScript(screen_msg..screenContent)
    end
    if sale_volume > 1 then
        for s = 1, #screens, 1 do
            screens[s].setRenderScript(screen_msg..screenContentMultiple)
        end
    end
    
    if containerSlot.getItemsVolume() == 0 then
        for l = 1, #lights, 1 do  
            lights[l].setColor(1,0,0)
        end
    end

    if containerSlot.getItemsVolume() > 0 then
        for l = 1, #lights, 1 do
            lights[l].setColor(0,1,0)
        end
    end
end

function F_container_update()    
    --Container check and output
    container_update = containerSlot.updateContent()
    container_table = containerSlot.getContent()

    upd_time_msg = math.floor(container_update)

    if #container_table == 0 then
        quantity_msg = 0
    else
        quantity_msg = math.floor(container_table[1].quantity)
    end
    
end
